# Data Schema — Alibaba PAI GPU Cluster Trace

## Raw Dataset

**File:** `data/alibaba_cluster_trace/pai_job_no_estimate_100K.csv`  
**Source:** Alibaba PAI GPU Cluster Trace 2022  
**Records:** ~100,000 job submissions  
**Window:** 7-day operational trace  
**Status:** Read-only — never overwrite.

### Raw Columns

| Column | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `job_id` | str | Unique job identifier (anonymized) |
| `submit_time` | int64 | Unix timestamp of job submission (seconds) |
| `duration` | float64 | Actual job runtime in seconds |
| `num_gpu` | int64 | GPU units requested |
| `num_cpu` | int64 | CPU cores requested |
| `user` | str | Anonymized user identifier |
| `gpu_type` | str | GPU hardware type (V100, A100, etc.) |
| `num_inst` | int64 | Number of job instances / workers |

### Filtering Rules (applied in `src/data_loading.py`)
- Drop rows where `duration <= 0`
- Drop rows where `num_gpu <= 0`
- Result: ~95K–100K valid records post-filtering

---

## Processed Dataset

**File:** `data/processed/100k_job_with_utilization.csv`  
**Generated by:** `notebooks/en/00_data_preparation.ipynb`

Contains all raw columns plus the following engineered features:

### Temporal Features

| Column | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `hour_sin` | float64 | `sin(2π × hour_of_day / 24)` |
| `hour_cos` | float64 | `cos(2π × hour_of_day / 24)` |
| `dow_sin` | float64 | `sin(2π × day_of_week / 7)` |
| `dow_cos` | float64 | `cos(2π × day_of_week / 7)` |

### Categorical Features (as-is; encoding applied per experiment)

| Column | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `user` | category | Categorical dtype (LightGBM native ready) |
| `gpu_type` | category | Categorical dtype |

### Sweep-Line Utilization Features

Computed at each job's `submit_time` using the O(N log N) sweep-line algorithm
in `src/feature_engineering.py`. Represents cluster state at job arrival.

| Column | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `cluster_load_gpu` | float64 | Fraction of total GPU capacity in use (0–1) |
| `cluster_load_cpu` | float64 | Fraction of total CPU capacity in use (0–1) |
| `active_job_count` | int64 | Number of jobs running at submission time |

---

## Target Variable

| Column | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `job_runtime` | float64 | = `duration` renamed; actual runtime in seconds |

**Distribution:** Heavy-tailed (log-normal shape). Log-scale visualization required.  
**Range:** ~1s to ~500,000s  
**Median:** ~few hundred seconds  
**Mean:** Much higher than median (dominated by long-tail jobs)

---

## Feature Sets by Experiment

### Numeric Features (exp_a, exp_c, exp_e)
```python
NUMERIC_FEATURES = [
    "num_gpu", "num_cpu", "num_inst",
    "hour_sin", "hour_cos", "dow_sin", "dow_cos",
    "cluster_load_gpu", "cluster_load_cpu", "active_job_count",
]
```

### One-Hot Features (exp_b)
```python
# All numeric + OHE expansion of user + gpu_type
# Top-50 users → 50 binary columns + 1 "other" column
# gpu_type → N binary columns (N = number of distinct types)
```

### Sequential Features (exp_c–f)
Rows sorted by `submit_time`, reshaped to `(N, seq_len, feature_dim)` for LSTM/CNN input.

---

## Data Quality Notes

- No null values after filtering
- `user` column has ~500–1000 distinct anonymized IDs
- `gpu_type` has ~5–10 distinct values (V100, A100, T4, etc.)
- `submit_time` is monotonically increasing within the trace (no out-of-order arrivals)
- `duration` exhibits heavy tail — log-transform recommended for visualization
